## JagDroid v0.45 (experimental)

**Battle Morph: sky and mountains fixed when turning.**

- v0.44 fixed the sheared mountain backdrop when flying straight, but a dark streaked wedge could still appear in the sky while turning, when the panorama wraps and is drawn in two pieces.
- The blitter now handles that wrapped case, so the mesas stay clean at every heading.
- Checked against the 57-game regression set: no other game changes.
